title: Removably detachable, modular power pack for a vacuum pad lifter

features.item: cordless handheld vacuum lifting device with integrated battery power
features.quote: Embodiments of a vacuum material handler or lifting device and system of this disclosure provide a modular design that allows a power pack to be mounted directly to the pad or remotely mounted on host equipment to minimize lift weight.
features.note: The reference describes a modular power pack that can be mounted directly to the pad, implying an integrated power source, but does not explicitly state it is a 'handheld' device or specifically 'cordless' in the sense of being battery-powered for handheld use, though it mentions a 'power source' and 'electric motor'.

features.item: flexible sealing lip on suction cup that bounds sealed region against workpiece
features.quote: a pair of vacuum lifter seals ( 12 ) connected to the arcuate-shaped lower end, each vacuum lifter seal located on opposite sides of a lateral centerline ( 13 ) of the longitudinally extending vacuum pad
features.note: The reference explicitly mentions 'vacuum lifter seals' which function as the flexible sealing lip bounding the sealed region.
features.refuted: The quote describes the location and connection of vacuum lifter seals, but does not mention a "flexible sealing lip" or that it "bounds a sealed region against a workpiece."

features.item: electric vacuum pump mounted within rigid body to draw air from sealed region
features.quote: Power pack 3 contains a power source, such as an electric motor, a vacuum source connected to the power source, and associated valving of a kind known in art.
features.note: The reference describes a power pack containing a vacuum source (which can be a vacuum pump, as per claim 10) and a power source (electric motor), which is mounted to the vacuum pad.
features.refuted: The quote mentions a "vacuum source connected to the power source" within the power pack, but does not explicitly state it is an "electric vacuum pump mounted within a rigid body" or that it "draws air from a sealed region."

features.item: pressure sensor monitoring vacuum level in sealed region
features.quote: A pad vacuum level sensor 24 may be included to indicate pipe ready to lift.
features.note: The reference explicitly mentions a 'pad vacuum level sensor' which monitors the vacuum level.

features.item: warning indicator activated when vacuum falls to threshold above release vacuum level
features.quote: Colored indicator lights 17 , such as red, amber or green light indicators, may be used to indicate a predetermined state of the vacuum lifting device and provide visual feedback to an operator.
features.note: The reference mentions indicator lights for a 'predetermined state' and a 'pad vacuum level sensor' to indicate 'pipe ready to lift', but does not explicitly state that a warning indicator activates when vacuum falls to a threshold *above* a release vacuum level.

features.item: warning threshold defined relative to load-release vacuum rather than working vacuum
features.note: The reference does not provide details on how the warning threshold for the vacuum level is defined or its relation to a load-release vacuum.

features.item: warning indicator remains active while grip vacuum persists below threshold
features.note: The reference mentions indicator lights but does not specify their behavior regarding persistence when vacuum levels are below a threshold.

features.item: rechargeable battery integrated into rigid body powering vacuum pump
features.quote: Electrical design features of embodiments may include combinations of the following features: an electric motor powered 380 volt 3-phase 50 Hz; a PLC system to manage pump run sequence; a pad vacuum sensor arranged to signal the operator when it
features.note: The reference mentions a 'power source' for the vacuum pump and a '12 volt battery to provide back up power to electronic systems', but it does not explicitly state that the primary power source for the vacuum pump is an integrated rechargeable battery, nor does it describe the main power source as a battery.

features.item: warning indicator positioned on rigid body for visibility during lifting operation
features.quote: Colored indicator lights 17 , such as red, amber or green light indicators, may be used to indicate a predetermined state of the vacuum lifting device and provide visual feedback to an operator.
features.note: The reference describes indicator lights that provide visual feedback to an operator, implying they are positioned for visibility during operation.
features.refuted: The quote mentions "Colored indicator lights 17" that provide "visual feedback to an operator" and indicate a "predetermined state." While this implies a warning indicator, it does not explicitly state it is "positioned on a rigid body for visibility during lifting operation."

features.item: single-hand portable design with all components carried by rigid body without external hose or cord
features.quote: Embodiments of a vacuum material handler or lifting device and system of this disclosure provide a modular design that allows a power pack to be mounted directly to the pad or remotely mounted on host equipment to minimize lift weight.
features.note: The reference describes a modular design where the power pack can be mounted directly to the pad, suggesting a self-contained unit without external hoses or cords when directly mounted. However, it does not explicitly state it is a 'single-hand portable design'.

overall.why: This reference is a patent document that describes a vacuum material handler with a modular power pack, which aligns very closely with the subject invention's features and claims, including specific components like vacuum lifter seals, power sources, vacuum sources, and control systems.
